coordinate_convention: Body-frame origin at virtual rear-left corner, x right along long width, y toward tape-access edge. Units mm. Not a declaration that all landmarks share one plane.

width.meaning: Main body side-to-side span, excluding side projections

height.uncertainty_note: Envelope sums ECMA component tolerances; not a directly printed IEC tolerance.

rear_to_prime_reference_line.meaning: Distance to reference datum; not total height

prime_reference_line_to_front.meaning: Distance from datum to tape-access edge

reel_center_spacing.meaning: Nominal reel axes / insertion-hole center separation

reel_axis_to_prime_reference_line.meaning: Perpendicular distance between reel axis and reference line

landmarks.derived_reel_centers_status: Historical nominal design coordinates; confirm against complete audio standard before runtime use. Fit fixed apertures, not movable teeth.

positioning_hole_pair_spacing.meaning: Inner reference/positioning-hole pair, not capstan pair

capstan_hole_pair_spacing.meaning: Outer small-hole pair near tape-access edge

capstan_hole_diameter.meaning: Visible capstan aperture reference, not reel opening

landmarks.positioning_hole_shape_policy: Use datum tangencies/observed boundaries. Do not assume all reference holes are identical circles.
landmarks.reel_opening_diameter_note: Not promoted from drawings: visible fixed shell rim, hub rim and drive teeth can be confused.

depth.step_assumption: Symmetric construction: (12.0 - 8.6)/2; do not force raised-front and main-face measurements into one homography.

calibration_excludes: short side projections / guide or grip rails
mask_policy: Preserve observed physical projections and closed transparent material; only observed open apertures may be removed.

iec_audio.scope: Audio cassette mechanical standard; scope and datum-definition preview checked; full dimensional figures not verified.

ecma34.scope: Withdrawn 1976 data-cassette standard; historical reference, not universal audio compliance.

us5566037.locator: Conventional C-cassette description and Figure 11; drawing PDF page 12

us5161079.locator: Conventional compact-cassette description and Figure 5; drawing PDF page 4

limitations: No cassette detector or real-photo validation is included.
Detailed hole tolerances are provisional historical ECMA references, not verified current audio-conformity requirements.
Source-image aspect ratio is not invariant under perspective.
Raised front, sidewalls, and main face are not coplanar.
